text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your thoughtful consideration, 
my liege, I was able to have a fulfilling 
rest. You have my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Only on that day would she set aside her 
sword to lose herself in reading, or take 
notes on phrases that could be used as 
names for sword techniques—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As a knight, I've taken another step 
forward in growth —that is how I feel.
